propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the freeze no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the oracle's blast radius narrowed and would miss regressions that unconditionally stamp updated_at in moved operations.
The unit test test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence pins the clear_absent no-stamp contract at the policy tier, containing the coverage risk from the integration oracle narrowing.

AC#2 cannot be satisfied via the integration test because clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass (only reachable for out-of-window-but-alive keys), so seeded unconditional-stamp mutations do not drive the test RED.
